features: ⚠️ THIS VERSION ADDS NO MIGRATIONS. It fixes the supplier record, which in some cases refused to save without saying anything: no green message, no red message, and the data not saved. An administrator reported it on the forum.

THE BUTTON THAT DID NOTHING — The program really was refusing the save, but on fields the screen had no way of displaying: the error existed and had nowhere to be printed. Now, when a save is refused, a panel at the top of the form lists what needs fixing, the page scrolls to it by itself, and each field shows its own red line. And when you fix the field, the warning disappears at once instead of staying until the next save.

SUPPLIERS THAT COULD NO LONGER BE SAVED, WHATEVER YOU TOUCHED — If a supplier had «subject to withholding tax» ticked and the «Tax code» field empty, its record was impossible to save: even just changing the phone number. The box is called «Manual override (optional)» and the program demanded it anyway. Now it really is optional, as it says: the rate stays mandatory only when you have not chosen a withholding regime, because that is the only case in which the calculation would not know which percentage to apply.

REAL DATA THAT WAS BEING REFUSED — The phone field accepted 20 characters, which is less than «06 1234567 / 333 1234567»: it now accepts 50, on phone, mobile and fax. Payment terms in days became a numeric field. And the limits that were wider than the database column — tax code, country, province — now match, so the refusal arrives next to the field instead of as a generic error.

THE EMAIL ADDRESS ALREADY IN USE NOW SAYS WHERE — The program checks that an address is not already used across contacts, suppliers and buildings. It used to say only «already in use», leaving you to search three archives by hand: now it says which one.

THE SUPPLIER CONTACT NO LONGER DISAPPEARS — Every save of the record removed the supplier's representatives, silently and with the green success message. Representatives are managed from their own page, where each has a role, and the supplier record no longer touches them. When creating a new supplier you can name one straight away, choosing its role.

THE MUNICIPALITY IS SEARCHED, NOT TYPED — Next to the «Municipality» field of the supplier record there is the search button on the ISTAT list, the same one already used on buildings: choosing the municipality also fills in the province code. The field stays editable by hand.

DETAILS — The «Municipality», «Postcode» and «Province» fields are in the order in which an address is written. Phone, mobile and fax show an example in the box. The «Save changes» button has the right icon and can no longer be selected by mistake instead of pressed. In the supplier area «contacts» are called «representatives» everywhere, as they already were on their own page.
